meta: Ask AI to help with a message that's hard to send: turning someone down nicely, or reminding a friend to pay you back without hurting the friendship. Day 1…

muc.title: Day 1: a hard message
muc.text: 7-day AI challenge, day one of seven: write a message that's hard to send, like a polite no or a reminder to pay you back.

muc.title: Ask AI for three tones
muc.text: Explain the situation to a chatbot, an AI assistant you chat with, and ask for three versions: gentle, direct and funny.

muc.title: No real names needed
muc.text: You don't need the person's real name. Just describe your relationship and what you want to say.

muc.title: Pick one, then edit it
muc.text: Choose the version that fits best and change a few words so it sounds like you, because the other person knows how you talk.

muc.title: Day 1 task
muc.text: Pick a message you've been putting off, do the three steps above in ten minutes, then send it.
